question: What reproducible read-only historical-control values of A2, S_ur0 and C2 can be extracted at the exact low-k onset anchors for the phenomenological regular matching subfamily defined by C10.65l?
sample: the four exact C10.65f low-k onset anchors only; no interpolation

definitions.A2: coefficient of k^2 in D_b(k)=D_b0+k^2 A2+O(k^4), D_b=delta_b-3 Psi_N on the historical control

acceptance: regenerate a disposable pinned production CLASS tree using the normal RTK production patch sequence plus the read-only C10 source and C10.65a species-control exporters
run only the four exact low-k modes from C10.65f and require a raw output row at exactly a_on within 1e-12 relative; do not interpolate
fit D_b versus x=k^2 with affine fits on the smallest three and all four anchors; require finite A2 and <=1e-4 relative nested-fit disagreement
fit sigma_ur/k^2 versus x with affine fits on the smallest three and all four anchors; require finite S_ur0 and <=1e-8 relative nested-fit disagreement
compute C(k) only from exported total matter source columns and H; do not use CLASS phi/psi in C(k)

fit C(k)/k^2 versus x on the smallest three and all four anchors; require finite C2 and <=0.1 relative nested-fit disagreement; if cancellation noise violates this, classify the historical C2 control as numerically unresolved rather than weakening the frozen threshold
report the constant-term leakage from a direct quadratic C(k)=C0+C2 k^2+C4 k^4 fit as a numerical cancellation diagnostic
label A2,S_ur0,C2 as HISTORICAL_PHENOMENOLOGICAL_CONTROL_ONLY and never as completed-U1 predictions
instantiate the C10.65l regular-control vector by setting E_gb2=E_urb2=E_khr2=R_gb0=R_urb0=R_khrb0=0 and inserting the extracted A2,S_ur0,C2 only if all numerical acceptance conditions pass
next_if_pass: freeze C10.65n conditional completed-U1 onset-seed construction using the C10.65m phenomenological control vector; solve the algebraic metric/shift auxiliaries for the 3x3 completion grid and perform onset-shift/low-k consistency tests before any full Boltzmann spectra run
non_claims: not a low-energy completed-U1 prediction of the matching values
not proof that zero relative entropies/velocities are UV-selected
